title: Why more oxygen burns hotter
note: Approved narration (tools/videos/DESIGN.md). Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); approved by AlanziM2. Editing a recorded script costs ElevenLabs credits.

sentences.say: Nitrogen does not burn, but it still plays a big part in every fire.
sentences.show: Nitrogen does not burn, but it still plays a big part in every fire.

sentences.say: In Earth's air, every oxygen molecule comes with almost four molecules of nitrogen.
sentences.show: In Earth's air, every oxygen molecule comes with almost four molecules of nitrogen.

sentences.say: A flame has to heat all of that nitrogen too. It acts like a sponge, soaking up heat.
sentences.show: A flame has to heat all of that nitrogen too. It acts like a sponge, soaking up heat.

sentences.say: Raise the oxygen percent, and there is less nitrogen to share the heat.
sentences.show: Raise the oxygen percent, and there is less nitrogen to share the heat.

sentences.say: In a Moon Base atmosphere of thirty percent oxygen, each oxygen molecule brings only about two and a third nitrogen molecules.
sentences.show: In a Moon Base atmosphere of thirty percent oxygen, each oxygen molecule brings only about two and a third nitrogen molecules.

sentences.say: In a spacesuit, filled with pure oxygen, there is none at all.
sentences.show: In a spacesuit, filled with pure oxygen, there is none at all.

sentences.say: With less nitrogen to warm, the flame burns hotter, spreads faster, and is harder to put out.
sentences.show: With less nitrogen to warm, the flame burns hotter, spreads faster, and is harder to put out.

sentences.say: This is why the same breathing does not mean the same fire risk.
sentences.show: This is why the same breathing does not mean the same fire risk.

sentences.say: It also explains how some extinguishers work. Carbon dioxide or helium dilutes the oxygen and carries heat away from the flame.
sentences.show: It also explains how some extinguishers work. Carbon dioxide or helium dilutes the oxygen and carries heat away from the flame.

sentences.say: NASA's FLEX experiment tested exactly that, on burning droplets aboard the space station.
sentences.show: NASA's FLEX experiment tested exactly that, on burning droplets aboard the space station.
